title: Committee
description: An FOMC-style committee. SPEC-COMM-3: each member carries continuous Taylor-rule reaction coefficients (inflation_coef, output_coef, inertia) rather than the older hawkish/dovish/neutral trichotomy. Empirical anchors live in docs/research/2026-06-02-fomc-empirical-anchors.md. SPEC-COMM-4: each member carries their own compromise_band for per-member dissent judgement.

name.description: Localization key for the committee name, e.g. comm.fomc_1979.name.

desc.description: Localization key for the committee description, e.g. comm.fomc_1979.desc.

id.description: Stable unique member id, e.g. member.chair.

name.description: Localization key for the member name, e.g. member.chair.name.

inflation_coef.description: Per-member weight on the inflation gap in the Taylor-rule preferred-rate computation. Empirical median ~1.7, hawks 1.8-2.0, doves 1.4-1.6.

output_coef.description: Per-member weight on the unemployment-gap term. memberPreferred subtracts `output_coef * (unemployment - target_unemployment)`, which is direction-equivalent to the classical Taylor rule's output-gap term. Empirical median ~0.4, hawks 0.25-0.35, doves 0.5-0.6.

inertia.description: Per-member smoothing on lagged policy rate; empirical range 0.85-0.92. High inertia is what makes the committee's preferred rates cluster meeting-to-meeting.

competence.description: Member competence score in [0, 1]. Reserved for future stochastic mechanics.

compromise_band.description: The range (in rate units) around the member's preferred rate they will assent to. |preferred - proposed| > compromise_band → dissent. SPEC-COMM-4.
